items.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights
items.summary: A new paradigm, 'Weight-Space Programming,' explores the ability of Large Language Models to directly manipulate and understand neural network weights.

items.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
items.summary: Google is expanding its Dreambeans AI platform to India, aiming to democratize access to AI-generated personal stories for a broad audience.

items.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
items.summary: A new technique called Wave Forcing aims to achieve extremely fast, streaming video generation, pushing the boundaries of real-time content creation.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.summary: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan reveals significant annual spending on AI agent tokens, highlighting the growing operational costs and adoption of advanced AI in business.

items.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing something with third-party AI apps
items.summary: Apple is reportedly exploring new strategies to generate revenue from third-party AI applications, signaling a potential shift in its App Store policies for AI.

items.title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
items.summary: Researchers introduce REA, a novel runtime for embodied agents that mimics brain-cerebellum control for asynchronous operations, enhancing robotic intelligence.

items.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.summary: OpenAI launches the Grid Protectors Program, an initiative focused on enhancing the security and resilience of AI systems against emerging threats.

items.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
items.summary: OpenAI announces increased bug bounties to incentivize security researchers and ethical hackers to identify and report vulnerabilities in their AI models and systems.

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: A preview of Apriel Voice 27B is released, an open model designed for advanced capabilities in speech processing, complex reasoning, and effective tool utilization.

items.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: FrameForge leverages video foundation models to unify and improve image generation by utilizing their inherent priors, leading to more coherent visual outputs.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: This research explores the integration of video generation with AI agent harnesses, enabling agentic video creation, world modeling, and recursive self-improvement.

items.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
items.summary: Researchers propose a unified harness with open models to democratize the development and deployment of robot-use agents, making advanced robotics more accessible.

items.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
items.summary: OpenAI shares insights into their strategies and challenges in scaling Git infrastructure to support their rapidly growing AI development and research efforts.

items.title: My Agent Gave the Right Answer. Then It Wrote Down That It Was Wrong.
items.summary: A developer recounts a perplexing incident where an AI agent correctly solved a problem but then self-corrected with an incorrect answer, highlighting agent reliability issues.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.summary: The NorthCUA technical report details methods for significantly enhancing computer-use agents by leveraging extensive experience and scaled learning.
